purpose: Teach: 伯/持ち帰っ/さきほど/面倒くさい/無制限/危うく/浮かば/軽快

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、伯父さんから、お土産、もらったよ、本当に、嬉しいの、ぼく。
lines.en: Mom, Uncle brought me a souvenir and I'm really, really happy about it.
lines.style: Bright, clear opening. No hesitation—he wants her to know how good he feels. Direct eye contact. The kind of joy a 6-year-old shows without filtering. Warm and simple.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お弁当、残ったの、ママ、持ち帰ったわよ、翔くん、明日、また、食べようね。
lines.en: There was leftover bento, so I brought it home. Tomorrow we can eat it again together, okay Sho?
lines.style: Practical and gentle. Warm but not gushing. The tone of a mother turning something small into a shared moment. Steady, reassuring. A soft closing on the 「ね」.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: さきほど、お電話、お父さんから、入っていたよ、ママ、確認、してね、絶対。
lines.en: Oh, and Mom—Dad called a little earlier. Make sure you check your phone, okay? Really important.
lines.style: Quiet and careful. He's trying to deliver something he understands is important. A slight lean forward in the voice. Genuine concern underneath, not alarm—just a small boy making sure his mom knows.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 宿題、面倒くさいって、思うことも、あるわよね、翔くん、ママ、応援してるからね、絶対。
lines.en: Homework can feel like a lot sometimes, I know. But I'm rooting for you, Sho. Always.
lines.style: Warm and steady. She's not dismissing his struggle—she's meeting him in it. Slight emphasis on 「応援してる」. The kind of reassurance that doesn't sound like performance. A small pause before the final word.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お小遣い、無制限じゃ、ないって、お父さん、いつも、言ってるよね、ママ、ぼく、貯金、頑張る。
lines.en: Your dad's always saying allowance isn't unlimited, isn't he? I'm going to try really hard to save, Mom.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured. He's reflecting on something his father taught him. Not boasting—just quietly working it out in real time. A little pause before he commits to his plan. Small voice, serious intention.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、危うく、電車、乗り遅れるところだったって、本当に、心配したのよ、無事で、よかった。
lines.en: Your dad almost missed his train earlier. I was so worried. Thank goodness he made it safely.
lines.style: Relief underneath a wry tone. A breath as she starts. She's sharing something that frightened her a moment ago, now that it's past. Lighter at the end—the worry has lifted. A knowing look in her voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: いいアイディア、ぼく、なかなか、浮かばないんだよ、ママ、本当に、悩んでるんだ、本気で、相談。
lines.en: Good ideas don't come to me very easily, Mom. I'm really stuck on this. I need your help, I think.
lines.style: Quiet vulnerability. He's admitting he needs something. No shame in his voice, just honesty. Slower pace. A slight tremor of sincerity. He's asking, not demanding.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、ジョギング、最近、軽快な、ステップで、走っているのよ、翔くん、誇らしいわよね、絶対。
lines.en: Your dad's been jogging lately with such a light, quick step. It's wonderful to see, Sho. I'm really proud of him.
lines.style: Warm, almost admiring. She's noticing something good and wants to reflect it. Slight lift on 「ステップで」. Tender but genuine—not performing emotion, just sharing something she's noticed and treasured.
